description: Source code implementing the Dining Philosophers problem using POSIX threads in Zephyr, including thread creation, mutex handling, and thread scheduling.

methods.name: fork_init
methods.description: Initializes a mutex for a fork.

methods.name: fork
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the fork mutex at a given index.

methods.name: set_phil_state_pos
methods.description: Sets cursor position for philosopher state display.

methods.name: print_phil_state
methods.description: Prints the current state of a philosopher, including priority and delay.

methods.name: get_random_delay
methods.description: Calculates a pseudo-random delay based on philosopher ID and uptime.

methods.name: is_last_philosopher
methods.description: Checks if the philosopher is the last one.

methods.name: philosopher
methods.description: Thread function simulating philosopher behavior: thinking, eating, and locking forks.

methods.name: new_prio
methods.description: Determines thread priority based on philosopher ID and configuration.

methods.name: start_threads
methods.description: Creates philosopher threads and sets their scheduling parameters.

methods.name: display_demo_description
methods.description: Displays the demo description if debug printing is enabled.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that runs the demo: displays description, initializes objects, starts threads, and waits if coverage is enabled.
